records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Lantern Works!
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Lantern Works* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Ana replied warmly and stated clear intent to add the team [email:58feb32b], a positive signal. But 6 days in there's still no first project, no invite and no key milestone despite two touches [email:d329f5c0, email:59c21e5d]; intent without action plus Starter solo usage leaves activation in 8 days uncertain.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Lantern Works' setup
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for the update — glad Wrenfield is landing well so far, and happy to help get the rest of the team in.

A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier for a larger group. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so it's usually worth having a first project ready for people to land in.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through adding the team and setting up that first project with you.

Best,
Nadia
